summary.text: Add a read-only verified-final-run outcome and make the workflow treat a complete same-date data archive as a successful no-op while preserving pending recovery.

mechanism.text: The workflow first checks exact report, snapshot, and receipt files on origin/data, then asks the CLI to verify the full committed archive before exiting without Telegram or a data push.

affectedComponents.detail: Same-date final publication is surfaced as ALREADY-PUBLISHED; pending and prepared recovery outcomes remain accepted.

designDecisions.decision: Verify the complete committed archive before skipping rather than treating the existence of one report file as success.
designDecisions.reason: This preserves fail-closed behavior for partial or conflicting state and prevents duplicate Telegram delivery.

technicalDetails.detail: A read-only copy of origin/data verified the existing 2026-08-24 report, snapshot, receipt, and manifest binding without provider or Telegram configuration.
The operations guide defines the meaning of each successful or recoverable status and the stop condition for other archive errors.
